covered_report_window: Tuesday, September 22, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Wednesday, September 23, 2026 before the U.S. market open
market_context_summary: The S&P 500 was near its record while the 10-year Treasury yield remained near 5% and Brent crude near $100 after a recent Fed rate hike; this especially raises rate and consumer sensitivity for KBH and GIS.

methodology.disparity_definition: Average of the normalized direction-score range and reversal-risk range, scaled 0-100; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Applied mandatory expectation-bar, key-metric-first, forward-look, and separate reversal-risk checks; no new framework change was warranted.
